notes: Event involves both PBAPS Units 2 and 3 (six cables across both units), but LER is filed under Unit 2 docket 05000277; Unit 3 is referenced but no separate Unit node created per docket-based identity. Fuse sizing/coordination issue traces to original construction design, consistent with cause code B (Design/Manufacturing/Installation) despite no acute equipment failure. No actual consequence occurred; consequence node models the potential/unanalyzed condition per the report's framing. Compensatory actions and circuit modification are corrective actions; three previous similar LERs cited as stubs with exact keys as stated in text.
